release_scope: Deploy current main including PR #218. In the POSP/MISP Documents workflow, the Eye/View action is now rendered from the existence of the uploaded document record instead of depending on transient signed-URL availability. Upload, replace, slot ordering, registration certificate logic, GST allocation, database, permissions, and workflow transitions are unchanged.
